description_en: Queries the automatic upgrade policy of a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeDeviceAutoUpgradePolicy查看智能接入网关设备运行软件的升级策略
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-device-auto-upgrade-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-kxe2cv7hot7qrv0000 --serial-number sage62x0225020000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDeviceAutoUpgradePolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: serial_number

parameters.help_en:
The type of the software for which you want to query the automatic upgrade policy. Valid values:

Device: The operating system that is run by the SAG instance.
Dpi: The signature database that is used by the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh:
要查看的软件类型：

Device：表示智能接入网关设备运行的操作系统软件。
Dpi：表示智能接入网关设备运行的应用特征库软件
parameters.name: version_type

CronExpression.description_en:
The time when upgrades start. The time was configured by using a cron expression.

Example value: `0 0 4 1/1 * ?`. The example value indicates that upgrades start at 04:00:00 (UTC+8) on the first day of each month
CronExpression.description_zh:
升级开始时间。升级开始时间使用cron表达式。

例如：`0 0 4 1/1 * ?`表示从每月第一天上午4时开始，每天执行升级操作

Duration.description_en:
The time period during which upgrades are performed.

Valid values: 30 to 120.

Unit: minutes
Duration.description_zh:
升级时间段。

取值范围：30~120。

单位：分钟

Jitter.description_en: The time differences between upgrades. Unit: minutes
Jitter.description_zh: 升级时间的上下偏差。单位：分钟

SerialNumber.description_en: The serial number of the SAG instance
SerialNumber.description_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号

SmartAGId.description_en: The ID of the SAG instance

TimeZone.description_en: The time zone in which the trigger period takes effect

UpgradeType.description_en:
The update type. Valid values:

scheduled: scheduled upgrade.
boot: automatic upgrade upon instance startup.
manual: manual upgrade
UpgradeType.description_zh:
升级类型。

scheduled：定时升级。
boot：开机自动升级。
manual：手动升级
